title.value: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) Registration Number

description.value: An Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) registration number is assigned to a practitioner for each profession in which they are registered. Practitioners registered in more than one profession have one registration number for each profession. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).

comment.value: This value is used for Australian FHIR Implementations.
